The committed D05 rows are context_only (SPICE geometry and POWER irradiance).
domain/features.py FEATURES contains terrain features only; D03/D05 ids are not admitted to scoring.py.

why_not_cross_body_similarity.reason: A radiometric brightness temperature depends on wavelength/band, emissivity assumption, local solar time, season and viewing geometry. Diviner bolometric Tb (unit emissivity) is not kinetic surface temperature, not Earth 2 m air temperature and not a Mars TI retrieval. There is no shared method/support pair.

Apparent thermal inertia is a retrieval from a thermal model (albedo, emissivity, atmospheric opacity, slopes, season). THEMIS 100 m and TES 2.96 km use different instruments, models and epochs. Earth does not have a matching retrieval at the same support.

Incidence and elevation are computed angles at a point and instant on a flat ellipsoid. They are not an observed flux, not a shadow fraction and not an irradiance. A geometry value cannot be compared with a daily 50 km reanalysis irradiance.

Irradiance requires a spectral band, atmosphere, surface orientation and time support. Earth POWER is daily all-sky broadband at about 50 km; TSIS TSI is 1 AU disk-integrated total solar irradiance; Moon/Mars have only geometry. These are different quantities and supports.

CRaTER supplies calibrated energy deposits, not absorbed dose. A Gy value requires spectral unfolding, detector response and shielding assumptions; a Sv value would require additional physics. No shared dose definition exists.

gaps.summary: Brightness temperature, thermal inertia, 2 m air temperature and skin temperature are different quantities with different methods and supports. No shared method/support pair exists.
gaps.evidence: surface_brightness_temperature_k is Moon-only evidence; thermal_inertia is Mars-only evidence; Earth D03 fields are context_only POWER reanalysis.
gaps.resolution: Keep all D03 typed values evidence_only/context_only; do not add D03 to scoring.py.

gaps.summary: No source checked supplies same-sol kinetic surface temperature or a true diurnal range at the 18 Moon AOIs.
gaps.evidence: PCP is a multi-year composite at one local-time bin; GCP is 0.5 degree and 2009-2015; GDR/GHRM exclude the polar AOIs; PRP is model-derived.
gaps.resolution: Keep diurnal_temperature_range_k empty or unknown; do not difference the two PCP bins.

gaps.summary: THEMIS quantitative TI stops at 60 N/S; TES TIMAP is global but 2.96 km; neither provides 100 m polar TI.
gaps.evidence: USGS product page states no mosaic above 60 deg; TES label says 20 pixels/degree (2.96 km/pix).
gaps.resolution: Do not claim Mars polar TI; any TES use must be a separate coarse context.

gaps.summary: Only solar geometry is available for Moon/Mars. No observed or modeled surface irradiance product at the existing sites was found.
gaps.evidence: SPICE produces incidence/elevation; TSIS TSI is 1 AU Earth-Sun total irradiance, not a planetary surface flux.
gaps.resolution: Keep solar_incidence_deg/solar_elevation_deg context_only; do not derive irradiance from geometry without a flux model and documented assumptions.

gaps.summary: CRaTER PDS data are calibrated energy deposits, not absorbed dose; LEND is neutron data (D04).
gaps.evidence: CRaTER catalog DATA_SET_NAME is 'CALIBRATED ENERGY DATA'; no Gy/Sv field was found. LEND RDR is neutron counts.
gaps.resolution: Do not populate ionizing_dose_gy without a documented spectral unfolding and shielding model; no Sv conversion.

gaps.summary: SPICE geometry uses a flat ellipsoid tangent plane; no DEM horizon, shadow fraction, observer height or visibility interval.
gaps.evidence: Committed pilot quality flags and notes explicitly exclude terrain horizon and shadow.
gaps.resolution: A future illumination product must document a DEM horizon model and validate frame registration; do not infer shadows from dark pixels.

gaps.summary: catalog/dimension-source-inventory.yaml lists an older Diviner URL and a 26-detected count; the committed pilot has 31 detected and the canonical URL is the PDS4 bundle path.
gaps.evidence: Inventory baseline says '26 detected'; observations.jsonl has 26 detected brightness-temperature rows plus 5 detected Mars TI rows (31 planetary detected). Inventory URL lro-l-diviner-3-rdr-v1/... does not match the verified PDS4 path.
gaps.resolution: Use this audit's verified URL and counts; update the inventory in a separate documentation PR, not in this audit's three files.

gaps.evidence: find/git ls-tree found no eligibility.py; compare eligibility is implemented in pipelines/src/analog_pipelines/ontology.py and cross_body_gate.py.

expansion_plan.scope: Read the 90S-80S GCP tile (156,211,313 bytes) and compute a 0.5 degree cell value for each of the 18 Moon AOIs. Store as a separate coarse_context method version, never as a 240 m PCP value.
expansion_plan.network: One full 156 MB ASCII table, explicit opt-in and checksum
expansion_plan.checkpoint: Cell overlap >=1; temporal overlap 2009-2015; label and table SHA-256 recorded; values flagged 0.5 degree; PCP and GCP rows never share a feature method version.
expansion_plan.not_claimed: No 1.98 km representativeness; no replacement for PCP; no global lunar survey.

expansion_plan.title: Mars D03 coarse context from TES TIMAP
expansion_plan.scope: Read the day and night 2.96 km TES maps and sample the five Jezero windows as separate coarse_context values; keep the interpolation mask and apply it.
expansion_plan.network: 51,840,000-byte day image + 25,920,000-byte night image + masks, explicit opt-in
expansion_plan.checkpoint: 2.96 km pixel covers the window centre; interpolation mask applied; method version distinct from THEMIS; no mixing with 100 m thermal_inertia.
expansion_plan.not_claimed: No 100 m Mars TI; no same-support comparison with THEMIS; no global Mars claim.

expansion_plan.title: Bounded Mars THEMIS 100 m extension within 60N/S
expansion_plan.scope: Add at most 3 new Mars reference windows inside the existing 00N060E tile or an adjacent verified tile; read only the 128 x 128 ISIS blocks touched by each 1.98 km window.
expansion_plan.network: About 0.3-1.3 MB of tile blocks per window, HTTP range requests
expansion_plan.checkpoint: Each window has >=1 native 100 m pixel; source tile checksum and byte ranges recorded; no resampling to 90 m; exact THEMIS method version.
expansion_plan.not_claimed: No global Mars coverage; no polar TI; no cross-body comparison.

expansion_plan.title: D05 SPICE time series at the existing nine sites
expansion_plan.scope: Reuse the five pinned kernels (18,718,944 bytes cached) and compute incidence/elevation at 1 h steps for one lunar day at the 4 Moon sites and one Mars sol at the 5 Mars sites. Bump the method version.
expansion_plan.network: No new download if the cache verifies; otherwise the same five pinned kernels
expansion_plan.checkpoint: Kernel SHA-256 unchanged; 24-25 samples per site; time support explicit; flat-ellipsoid and no-horizon caveats retained; no irradiance derived.
expansion_plan.not_claimed: Still model-derived geometry, not observed irradiance, shadow fraction or ionizing radiation.

expansion_plan.title: D05 Earth-only TSI context from TSIS-1
expansion_plan.scope: If a new total_solar_irradiance_w_m2 feature is approved, ingest the 24 h TSIS TSI series as Earth-Sun context. Do not map it to surface_shortwave_irradiance_kwh_m2_day.
expansion_plan.network: One ~0.5 MB text file, or a bounded range for metadata
expansion_plan.checkpoint: New feature id, unit W/m^2, 1 AU support and method version approved; license verified; no planetary surface claim; no cross-body score.
expansion_plan.not_claimed: No Moon/Mars irradiance; no surface irradiance; no dose.

expansion_plan.title: D05 ionizing dose from CRaTER
expansion_plan.scope: No ingestion. A future task would need spectral unfolding, detector response, shielding geometry and an absorbed-dose definition.
expansion_plan.network: Metadata only until a documented dose product exists
expansion_plan.checkpoint: Blocked: no direct Gy product; no Sv conversion without physics; no surface support.
expansion_plan.not_claimed: No dose value, no equivalent dose, no habitability inference.

expansion_plan.title: Diviner GDR/GHRM or RCP for new lower-latitude AOIs
expansion_plan.scope: Only if a new non-polar Moon AOI is approved. GDR L3 stops at 80N/S, GHRM at 70N/S, and RCP Lacus Mortis is a separate region; none expands the current polar AOIs.
expansion_plan.network: Bounded image/tile reads; no full mosaic
expansion_plan.checkpoint: New AOI and science question approved; method version separate from PCP; no claim of polar coverage.
expansion_plan.not_claimed: No expansion of the existing 18 polar windows; no global lunar survey.

expansion_plan.title: Use PDS ODE only as a discovery service
expansion_plan.scope: Keep the ODE REST query as a discovery aid for LRO/DLRE product ids; do not treat ODE search results as observations.
expansion_plan.checkpoint: Every ODE-discovered product is re-verified against its PDS label and HTTP evidence before ingestion.
expansion_plan.not_claimed: ODE is not an observation source and does not establish coverage.

reproduction.notes: The checker is stdlib-only and safe to run repeatedly. It never downloads a full raster, table or kernel; full bodies are capped at 256 KiB and range responses at 4 KiB.
